newsitem.title: CHINA: COSCO Pacific pays HK$23.88/shr for LCH Bank stake.
newsitem.headline: COSCO Pacific pays HK$23.88/shr for LCH Bank stake.

text.p: COSCO Pacific Ltd said on Tuesday it had agreed to buy a 17.25 percent stake in Liu Chong Hing Bank Ltd from Liu Chong Hing Estate Co Ltd and the Liu family for HK$1.65 billion, or HK$23.88 per share.

COSCO Pacific said in a statement that it would buy 64 million shares from Liu Chong Hing Estate, a wholly-owned unit of Liu Chong Hing Bank parent Liu Chong Hing Investment Ltd, and five million shares from the Liu family.
It said it would buy a further five percent of Liu Chong Hing Bank, or 20 million shares, from its parent COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd for HK$477.60 million.

"Diversification into the financial services sector will provide significant long term savings in relation to the financing of the company's core business operations as well as being a new profit centre for the company," COSCO Pacific said.

In a separate statement, Liu Chong Hing Bank said it had agreed to issue 45 million new shares, or 11.25 percent of its existing share capital, to Liu Chong Hing Estate at HK$23.88 per share. The HK$1.07 billion raised before expenses would be used for general funding purposes, Liu Chong Hing Bank said.
"The directors of LCH Bank consider that the enlargement of the capital base of LCH Bank as a result of the subscription will enhance its future development," it said.
"It is also believed that COSCO Pacific will be able to assist LCH Bank in the development of its business in the People's Republic of China," Liu Chong Hing Bank added.
After the transactions, Liu Chong Hing Estate would have a 43.98 percent stake in Liu Chong Hing Bank compared with a current 53.68 percent.
COSCO Pacific would have a 20 percent stake and the Liu family would hold 3.97 percent compared with a current 5.66 percent.

COSCO Pacific said it would fund the acquisition from internal resources and banking facilities. It said it intended to hold the shares as a long term investment and had no current plans to increase or decrease its interest.
Trading in Liu Chong Hing Bank has been suspended since July 10 and was due to resume on Tuesday.
The stock last traded at HK$24.30.

Trading in COSCO Pacific and Liu Chong Hing Investment shares has been suspended since July 11 and was also due to resume on Tuesday. COSCO Pacific last traded at HK$15.80 and Liu Chong Hing Investment at HK$12.95.
